report_discrepancies.note: Proprietary statement p7: Water operating income printed 73,032 but charges for services 169,991 - total operating expenditures 100,125 = 69,866 (Total column 86,336 vs 278,528 - 195,358 = 83,170). The 3,166 is the business-type 'Other miscellaneous revenues' printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) but not as a line on p7; recorded as a business-type receipt from p2 so the roll-forward ties.

notes: Modified cash basis village (basis recorded as cash), choices aligned with FY2023. Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds statement (p4-5); business-type from the proprietary statement Total column (p7) plus 'Other miscellaneous revenues' 3,166 from the Statement of Activities (p2), which p7 omits as a line but includes in operating income. Fund balance roll-forward: 536,676 + 997,494 - 695,912 = 838,258 (General/Streets transfers (100,000)/100,000 net to zero; Total column prints none, so transfers null as in later years). Business-type: 452,522 + 284,493 - 233,048 = 503,967. Cash fields: governmental funds 'Cash and cash equivalents' (p3, 2022 and 2021 Total columns); CDs as investments; restricted cash and county treasurer cash are separate lines. Balance sheet: governmental lines from p3 (totals equal p1 governmental 838,258; p3 prints Restricted for Community development 1,139 where p1 splits community improvement 1,137 / community development 2), business-type from p1. Detail: General Fund combining schedule by department (p9); utility funds and Streets Fund have no own schedules, so no statement-column lines added (as FY2023/FY2024). The all-funds budget schedule (p8) prints only broad Taxes/Federal/State/Local groups and is not recorded. Read pages 1-9 of 9
